name: block-settings-form
title: Settings form block
description: Settings sections of switches and selects, each in a fieldset.
a11y: Each section is a fieldset with a legend, so grouped controls are announced with it.
Switches have role=switch with visible labels; hints are linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional muted line under the heading.

props.name: sections
props.description: The groups of settings; each has a `legend`, optional `description` and a list of switch or select `items`.

props.name: saveLabel
props.description: Text of the submit button. Default "Save changes".

props.name: resetLabel
props.description: Text of the button that restores the initial values. Default "Reset".

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with every control's value: switches are `true` or `false`, selects their value.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner on the save button while you save.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Outline level of the title, 1 to 3. Default 1.
